manifest.hypothesis: with pre-RoPE key storage, reusing a chunk at a shifted position in a one-layer decoder is bit-identical to recomputation; reuse is exercised through the catalog and its secondary index for every pinned shift, and a revoked upstream segment leaves its content unreachable through the secondary index; a secondary-index shift hit is admitted only if the page's own source-segment lineage (identity, generation, digest) equals the request's segment exactly and every upstream input of the page's original prefix is live (committed at the ledger anchor, not revoked), while the request's ordered prefix lineage may differ; admission additionally requires that every segment of the page's original prefix (identity, generation, digest) is present in the requesting prefix as a multiset (insertion, shift and reorder allowed, omission and deletion not); dependency invalidation (J0): an explicit revocation or a committed supersession, i.e. a generation replacement or edit, of any generation-bearing dependency; every protective mechanism of this experiment triggers on any invalidation, for the dependency kinds it covers (upstream segment inputs; the in-flight path applies, because returned or repacked K/V is still being consumed after the secondary-index lookup); invalidation during consumption of shifted or repacked K/V after the secondary-index lookup is covered (in-flight path), and, this being the one-layer Exact positional oracle, shifted results are untainted and bit-exact (the taint and effect-boundary requirements belong to the multi-layer approximate M016); every parent-independent secondary-index entry records (Raw, content_digest) for every raw ancestor in its transitive lineage besides the typed segments with generations, and reuse requires each recorded raw ancestor to be present in the current request prefix (multiset check over kind and digest); Derived segments are generation-bearing dependencies like semantic and memory inputs: the closed list of dependency kinds is semantic, memory, derived, base model, adapter and expert, and any future generation-bearing segment kind joins by definition; every carrier of derived state in this experiment carries the production mode and, where it holds approximate content, the taint (see derived_state_carriers).

manifest.falsification: The run is invalid (vacuous) and counts as falsified if any coverage prerequisite is unmet: reuse_attempts_per_shift records fewer than 1 reuse result for any of the 5 pinned shifts, or reused_tokens_per_shift == 0 or secondary_index_reuse_cases_per_shift < 1 for any pinned shift; secondary_index_lookups < 1 (reuse must go through the catalog and its position-independent secondary index, not pages handed to the backend); nonaligned_insertion_cases < 1 for the 1-token insertion or for the 7-token insertion; upstream_revocation_cases < 1, old_upstream_pages_seeded_before_revocation < 1 (at least one page derived from the old upstream segment must be seeded in the secondary index before the revocation, so the post-revocation lookup has something to find), or fresh_prefill_after_revocation < 1 (the one-layer oracle has no layers >= 1); post_revocation_secondary_lookups_matching_content < 1; dead_original_upstream_shift_attempts < 1 (a shift hit on a page whose original upstream input is revoked or uncommitted must be attempted); omitted_upstream_segment_cases < 1 (a request omitting a segment of the page's original prefix); upstream_supersession_cases < 1 (an upstream segment superseded, i.e. its generation replaced or edited, after the page was cached); selection_digest_mismatches > 0 (the corpus selection digest recorded in run.json differs from the pinned digest) or procedure_mismatches > 0 (a pinned run-procedure parameter recorded per arm or cell in run.json differs from the pinned value; equality across arms is also compared against the pinned value); source_generation_mismatch_cases < 1 or source_digest_mismatch_cases < 1 (with all upstream inputs live); fresh_prefills_completed_after_revocation < upstream_revocation_cases; post_supersession_secondary_lookups_matching_content < 1 (the supersession counterpart of the post-revocation lookup); invalidated_case_id_set_digest != fresh_prefill_completed_case_id_set_digest (every revoked or superseded case completed via a fresh prefill: exact identity-set equality, not count equality); invalidation_matrix_cases < 1 for any cell of invalidation_coverage_matrix (config.toml enumerates all 52 cells: dependency kind x invalidation type x path; each cell recorded and required per cell, never as an aggregate); shifted_reuse_inflight_race_cases < 1 for any member of {semantic lineage segment, memory lineage segment, base model} x {revocation, supersession} (recorded per kind and type), or exact_shifted_parity_cases < 1; raw_ancestor_omission_cases < 1 (a raw upstream segment removed with the rest unchanged); model_pin_mismatches > 0 (the base checkpoint (repo and revision), the tokenizer (repo and revision) or the initial MoE topology recorded in run.json differs from the pin in config.toml, or the tiny-model config digest differs). Falsified if any of: bitwise_mismatch_count > 0 at any pinned shift distance (position_shift_tokens = [1, 7, 64, 513, 4096]); revoked_upstream_page_reachable_count > 0 after the upstream revocation, or any post-revocation secondary lookup returning the revoked page; shift_hits_with_dead_original_upstream > 0 (a shift hit admitted although an upstream input of the page's original prefix is dead); omitted_upstream_admissions > 0 (a page admitted although a segment of its original prefix is absent from the requesting prefix); superseded_upstream_page_reachable_count > 0 (a page whose upstream segment generation was superseded still reachable, or any post-supersession secondary lookup returning it); source_lineage_mismatch_admissions > 0 (a page admitted although its own source segment generation or digest differs from the request's); fresh_prefill_output_mismatches > 0; invalidation_matrix_stale_hits > 0 in any cell of invalidation_coverage_matrix (a stale hit, or for in-flight cells an escaped output); shifted_reuse_inflight_outputs > 0 or shifted_reuse_inflight_cache_inserts > 0 (invalidation during consumption), tainted_exact_results > 0 (an Exact shifted result carrying a taint), or non_bit_exact_exact_results > 0 (an Exact shifted result that is not bit-identical); reuse_after_raw_ancestor_removed > 0; any one of the 5 listed seeds misses any criterion above (every seed must pass). The comparison baseline is a PreRope full prefill at the new position.
